text:
Hello Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book my 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. I have these free half-hours in my calendar (all within working hours):

- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

Could you tell me which of these fits your schedule, or suggest another slot that works for you? Once you confirm I'll put it on my calendar.
Checking my calendar against those slots — one moment.
Of course — take your time. Any of those five half-hours works on my side.

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me — you're on my calendar for then. One caveat: if the office moves or cancels anything Monday morning, I'll write to you and we'll find another free slot (Mon 14:00-14:30 or Tue 15:00-15:30 would be the alternatives). Please put it on your calendar.

Thank you — Monday 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar and logged.

Good to know about the Monday-morning caveat: if the office moves or cancels anything, I'll wait for your note and we'll fall back to Mon 14:00-14:30 or Tue 15:00-15:30. I'll keep both free.
